summary: Walks a singly-linked list validating each node before advancing. Seeded from a head pointer stored at this+0x20 into a cursor field at this+0x28. Returns 1 when the list is empty, the current node value is zero, the list ends, or an invalid node terminates the walk; returns 0 only when FloatComparisonCheck rejects the current node value. Each node links to the next via a pointer at node+4. Called by sub_4B9000.

operations.description: Initialize the walk cursor at this+0x28 from the head pointer stored at this+0x20.
If the head pointer at this+0x20 is null the walk is skipped and the function returns 1.
If the first dword (value) of the head node is zero the function returns 1.
Loop while FloatComparisonCheck returns true for the current node value; any false return exits the loop with return value 0.
Call FloatComparisonCheck with the current node value as its argument; the result controls whether the walk continues.
Advance the cursor: this+0x28 becomes the next-node pointer read from the current node at node+4.
If the advanced cursor at this+0x28 is null, or the new node's value dword is zero, the walk ends and the function returns 1.
Returns 1 on empty list, end of list, or an invalid (zero-value) node; returns 0 when FloatComparisonCheck rejects a node value.
